defects.defect: Both assertions that printed date and metadata establish Jun. 14, 1935 contradict the source.

reasons: The actual full input assigns 1935-06-14 to clause first_end and whole_order_end. The cited source ends December 19, 1934, and the independently checked APP page record also dates this exact order 1934-12-19. Its present adoption and cancellation are unconditional, with no later effective condition. June 14 is the later statutory repeal, not completion of this cancellation.

The research_rationale twice misstates the printed/metadata date as Jun. 14, 1935 while judgment_reason correctly says December 19, 1934. Those contradictions are substantive; the source hashes and quotations being correct do not cure the false date.

EO6543J independently identifies the parent approval of December 30, 1933. Expected coverage by Trucking and Construction codes is recital context, not a new future transfer command. The cancellation/adoption completion theory otherwise fits the held operative language.
